mapper.sql: request_id, credential_id, event_type, event_name, correlation_type, correlation_value, variables_sha256, matched_process_instance_id, matched_execution_id, status, result_code, result_summary, create_time, complete_time
mapper.select: select from wf_runtime_event_request order by create_time desc, request_id desc limit 1000
select from wf_runtime_event_request where request_id = #{requestId} for update
mapper.insert: insert into wf_runtime_event_request (request_id, credential_id, event_type, event_name, correlation_type, correlation_value, variables_sha256, status, create_time) values (#{requestId}, #{credentialId}, #{eventType}, #{eventName}, #{correlationType}, #{correlationValue}, #{variablesSha256}, 'RECEIVED', current_timestamp(3))

insert into wf_runtime_event_request (request_id, credential_id, event_type, event_name, correlation_type, correlation_value, variables_sha256, status, result_code, result_summary, create_time, complete_time) values (#{requestId}, #{credentialId}, #{eventType}, #{eventName}, #{correlationType}, #{correlationValue}, #{variablesSha256}, 'FAILED', #{resultCode}, #{resultSummary}, current_timestamp(3), current_timestamp(3))
mapper.update: update wf_runtime_event_request set matched_process_instance_id = #{matchedProcessInstanceId}, matched_execution_id = #{matchedExecutionId}, status = 'PROCESSED', result_code = #{resultCode}, result_summary = #{resultSummary}, complete_time = current_timestamp(3) where request_id = #{requestId} and status = 'RECEIVED'
